purpose: Tune paper stock/option expression allocation parameters on prior replay rows and evaluate the selected parameters on later replay rows.

temporal_rule.train: Only rows before each test window may be used to select parameters.
temporal_rule.test: Later rows are evaluated with the selected train-window parameters.
temporal_rule.forbidden: Do not use realized PnL, allocation regret, hindsight-best expression, or test-window outcomes as signal-time selection inputs.

live_replay_evidence.command: python main.py replay-score-strategy-walk-forward-tune --start 2025-01-01 --scorer-name openai --model-name gpt-5.4-mini --scorer-version openai-replay-score-v14-nuanced-v1 --price-source yahoo_chart_daily_adjclose --limit 1000 --min-train-rows 240 --test-window-rows 80 --step-rows 80 --underlying-reference-price 100 --stock-quantity 10 --stock-stop-loss-pct 0.02 --min-confidence-grid 0.30,0.35 --min-stock-expected-return-grid 0.0025,0.005 --min-option-score-grid 0.30,0.35,0.40 --min-option-return-on-risk-grid 0.0,0.10 --option-preference-edge-grid 0.05,0.10 --min-dte 7 --base-implied-vol 0.55 --risk-free-rate 0.04 --contract-multiplier 100 --moneyness-offset-pct 0.0 --spread-width-pct 0.05 --min-selection-rate 0.45 --pnl-weight 0.35 --regret-penalty-weight 0.25 --option-usage-penalty-weight 0.05 --top-n 5

known_limitations: The first wide-grid run exceeded the interactive timeout; the accepted M100 evidence uses a narrower operational grid.
Option candidates remain theoretical and are not yet constrained by real bid/ask, open interest, implied-volatility surface, assignment, or margin.
Stock max loss still uses a stop-loss proxy rather than simulated stop execution.
Future versions should combine this walk-forward selector with M98 live option liquidity filters during market hours.
